# Baeldung

> A comprehensive resource for Java, Spring, and web development tutorials with transparent site analytics and public iteration practices.

Baeldung is a widely-used educational platform focused on Java and Spring technologies, featuring hands-on tutorials, courses, and detailed technical guides. The site maintains transparency through Meta Baeldung, which shares quarterly reports, traffic analytics, and content strategy updates with the community.

## Key Topics

- Java
- Spring Framework
- Spring Boot
- REST APIs
- CRUD Operations
- Spring Controllers
- Course Development
- CI/CD
- Jenkins
- Public Iteration
- Traffic Analytics
- Content Strategy
- Quarterly Reports
- GitHub
- Postman

## Site Overview & About

- [About | Meta Baeldung](http://meta.baeldung.com/about): About page detailing Baeldung's Java/web focus and public iteration process
- [Meta Baeldung](http://meta.baeldung.com/): Meta Baeldung hub sharing quarterly reports, traffic analytics, and site updates

## Spring & REST API Courses

- [Lesson 2: Expanding Our First Controller | Baeldung - Learn Spring](https://courses.baeldung.com/courses/487981/lectures/10132704): Spring 5/Boot 2 tutorial covering controller expansion, CRUD, and REST APIs

## Optional

- [Dashboard - Jenkins](https://jenkins.baeldung.com/): Jenkins CI/CD dashboard monitoring Baeldung build status and project health
